Priya R: Heads up — noticed ~2.3k invoices from last week tagged with 'exp_pricing_v2' and they were billed at the experiment rate ($0.75/1k) instead of prod ($1.00/1k). Unsure how long it's been live. Can someone confirm?
Miguel B: Can you paste a sample invoice id? I'll run a quick query against billing ledger.
Priya R: sample: INV-20260316-9987
Miguel B: Running query now:
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, metadata->>'pricing_flag' AS flag, charged_amount, created_at
FROM invoices
WHERE metadata->>'pricing_flag' = 'exp_pricing_v2'
AND created_at >= '2026-03-15'::date;
```
Miguel B: Quick results — count: 2321 invoices, gross charged sum = $112,350, expected at prod rate = $130,800. Approx revenue delta = $18,450 (undercharged). Flag flip event in deploy logs at 2026-03-15 03:12:04 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: flag toggle event 2026-03-15T03:12:04Z by ci/release-2026.3.15
Alice F: Yikes. Need proposal: do we backbill customers or issue credits + notify? Any legal constraints here? @Emma L
Emma L: We generally avoid retroactive charges without explicit consent unless TOS is clear. Recommend credits + notice for most customers, manual outreach for high-ACV accounts.
Priya R: I'll segment affected list. Proposal: auto-credit small accounts (<$500 impact), offer invoice correction option for mid accounts ($500-5k), manual sales outreach for >$5k. Thoughts?
Carlos M: I support credits-first + outreach for >$5k. Exec sign-off: approved to proceed with credits + messaging. :thumbsup:
Miguel B: Technical plan: generate negative adjustment invoices with reason='pricing-experiment-leak', add audit metadata, and run as draft first. Command I'll use in staging: `/billing-backfill --from=2026-03-15 --flag=exp_pricing_v2 --mode=draft` — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/4321
Priya R: Uploading full export to drive for segmentation: https://drive.redwood/finance/exp-pricing-leak-2181234567.xlsx Will tag ACV>100k for sales outreach.
Miguel B: I'll hold the final run until legal, finance ops, and sales confirm messaging. ETA for draft run: EOD tomorrow.
Alice F: Finance will prepare a journal entry template for the adjustments and a short customer note. Priya, please copy me on the list.
Priya R: Will do — I'll post final counts + delta in #finance-ops first thing tomorrow. Thanks all. :pray:
